results.title: The Leap
results.overview: Josué is about to embark on a new chapter in his life. Together with his pregnant partner, he is preparing a room for their son and hanging photographs from the past on the walls – snippets of life from the family chronicle, to which they will soon add new chapters. Set against the backdrop of contemporary Cuba, a quiet social and relational drama centred on a young family on the threshold of an uncertain future unfolds in this delicate observation.

results.title: Doubt
results.overview: A couple of months away from his ordination, young Catholic deacon Jean decides to briefly join a remote monastery in Luxembourg to decide whether he’s more suited to monastic life. His days are spent in prayer, ritual, choir practice, and quiet observation of the peaceful life there. However, the arrival of a visitor, an attractive young man who also happens to be a benefactor to the monastery, awakens unsettling feelings Jean struggles to identify. Soon, Jean is forced to confront his convictions, but also the very foundation of his sense of belonging.

results.title: Pee Mak
results.overview: Mak, a soldier returning home from war, invites four of his comrades to meet his wife and newborn child. However, suspicion soon grows among his friends as they uncover a terrifying secret: Mak’s family is no longer among the living.

results.title: Révolution Française (Rappel)
results.overview: “I am, we are. / We do not need more. / It’s up to us to start.” The energy of the revolutionary people and the words of the revolution, through the history of cinema, from its origins. Reminder: we must take back the Bastille.

results.title: Alwest
results.overview: The land of Omeray, caught up in political conflicts, is gradually being invaded by a powerful army. Grégeois, a high-ranking official, is one of the last lines of defense against this threat. When he is attacked, he manages to send one final magical message to Hélèse, the leader of the village where his children live, to warn them of the approaching danger.

results.title: Inhumation
results.overview: After being pronounced dead prematurely, a man afflicted with a rare condition is determined to put his fears to rest - no matter the cost.

results.title: The Promise
results.overview: Ten years ago, Lily spent a summer in Paris and met Thomas. Together, they made a promise, and today is the day to keep it.

results.title: Afreet - A Never Ending Night
results.overview: Three friends gather for what should have been an ordinary evening, but a seemingly harmless challenge unleashes something far older and more dangerous than they could have imagined. As strange events begin to blur the line between reality and the unknown, they find themselves trapped in a night where every choice carries a consequence.  Afreet is a supernatural horror film that explores friendship, fear, and the hidden forces that emerge when curiosity goes too far.

results.title: Guardians of the Video Game
results.overview: Falling from cutting-edge 3D games into a forgotten pixel RPG, an exiled guardian of the gaming world must secretly guide an innocent hero to the ending, uncover the conspiracy out to destroy him and the game itself.

results.title: The Six
results.overview: In the early 1980s, six young people came together in Antwerp and, armed with nothing but vision, courage, and radical independence, transformed the fashion world. Forty years later, they look back on a time when creativity trumped convention and commerce.

results.title: Job Seeker
results.overview: A first encounter between a jobless gay and a job seeker and it is also a love story. Both characters connect as they understand one another and share their feelings. This film is an episode that feels warm and is full of joy in the little things.

results.title: Vocabulary
results.overview: Andy, a young chunky Chinese newcomer, arrives in London’s gay scene full of wonderful dreams. What he finds instead: somewhat racist Grindr bios, slang he can’t decipher (“bog roll”), and rules no dictionary can teach. Over three sex/dates, he stumbles through the unspoken vocabulary of sex, love, and belonging.

results.title: I'll Be Doggone
results.overview: Describing the last visit to a loved ones home, stripped of its character and put on the market, with the backdrop of the destruction of the animatronic band, The Rock-afire Explosion.

results.title: Last Night at the Alamo
results.overview: A canceled Hollywood actor travels to Pittsburgh in an attempt to revive his career and ends up involved with a group of wannabe left-wing terrorists.
